goal: Extract the nested Type implementation classes out of TypeUtils to reduce class size: GenericArrayTypeImpl, ParameterizedTypeImpl, WildcardTypeImpl and the WildcardTypeBuilder.

ops.details: Create a top-level package-private class GenericArrayTypeImpl in package org.apache.commons.lang3.reflect with the same fields and methods as the inner class. Keep calls that reference TypeUtils (e.g., TypeUtils.equals, TypeUtils.toString) unchanged so the new class delegates to TypeUtils where needed. Update TypeUtils.java to remove the nested class and import nothing extra (same package).

Create a top-level package-private class ParameterizedTypeImpl in package org.apache.commons.lang3.reflect replicating the inner class implementation. Maintain usage of TypeUtils.equals and TypeUtils.toString from the new class. Update TypeUtils to remove the nested class definition and reference the new top-level class.

Create a top-level package-private class WildcardTypeImpl in package org.apache.commons.lang3.reflect with the same implementation as the nested class. Keep calls to TypeUtils.toString and TypeUtils.equals as-is. Update TypeUtils to remove the nested class definition and reference the new top-level class.

Create a top-level public class WildcardTypeBuilder in package org.apache.commons.lang3.reflect containing the builder implementation. Update TypeUtils.wildcardType() to instantiate and return the new WildcardTypeBuilder. Ensure visibility remains compatible (the builder was public static).

Update related tests affected by this refactoring block so the configured build command passes. Adjust imports, package references, moved class references, constructors, and assertions only when required. Do not change production behavior through tests.
